qualifications: Explicit unused-header confirmation: neither include/game/screen.h nor include/game/item_pages.h is included directly or transitively by any c002 unit. Checked all preprocessor include directives across the 38 wave1 units and 7 accepted pilot units: only func_0011e928.c and func_00195254.c include game/bss_0049ecf0.h, and only func_0018fdd4.cpp and func_0018fd20.cpp include game/result.h. Both reachable headers were read and contain no further includes. The frozen game flags and tools/toolchain.py command construction add include search paths, not forced preincludes. The two extra prepared headers are therefore outside the entire 45-unit credited translation-unit include closure; they receive no function credit here.

All 38 new functions were independently rerun sequentially with tools/match.py under profile game for c002-wave1-r3: 38 MATCH results, 1584 bytes. Each source/catalogue binding agrees with this prepare. Independently hashed the seven accepted pilot source units as well; their hashes agree with prepare and there are no revised units. Read both prepared fresh-build receipts: 55 total functions / 2680 bytes, identical code.bin and ExeFS .code hashes, no cached units. No full build, full suite, finalization retry or runtime test was run by this reviewer.

All four prepared headers were read and independently hashed against prepare.headers, including a pre-seal hash check and unfiltered project-header inventory. bss_0049ecf0.h = e24dd2bb970c2e14e2ed2b83375ee93ad64f8cabedbecca2643bbc46f5a73fc6; result.h = d3e9723ddd7a08fa81e968adfdc0bd916bb87bef3022b78b9cd832a62fd3a461; screen.h = 90c0a3f4c0ae5160b2038741a1b3eef0953214529bb19befa6834930fee41a6d; item_pages.h = fcdf0170ff46de270b8007716c87b29ae56d5f214ec315bf8a232979dbae8e66. No source-local header files were found. Reviewed v1.5 exact-prepared-file review binding and the still-strict whole-header-tree finalize consumer; the reported r2 process failure was accepted as ground truth, not retried.

Manually rechecked all nine new C++ units against the current credited source declarations and own original target/caller packets, not another review. These packets were independently generated for the same pinned code.bin and catalogue, whose hashes are unchanged; this round used fresh match.py invocations for every function. Result still has one shared definition; the prior ODR defect remains fixed. Partial resource classes, tagged handles, reserved virtual slots and destructor recovery remain 32-bit target descriptions, not complete SDK types or portable native-port proofs.

The source-language qualifications published in docs/known-issues-c002-wave1-r2.md cover the byte-identical 38-function source set and apply unchanged to r3; they are explicitly scoped to r3 in this record. In particular, func_00196cb8 retains its annotated invalid-screen before-table path if the error handler returns. Valid index bounds and error-handler return behavior are not established. The additional unused headers are confirmed outside c002, not reviewed as wave-2 implementations.

The shared CommandSystem fields and produced command kind 1 were rechecked against the original dispatcher: there is an explicit consumer forwarding source and size, not a silent drop. Direct v3 catalogue inspection found exactly 38 ordinary function owners totalling 1584 bytes, no veneer or multi_entry credit. Callee entry 0x12d5c4 is inside an uncredited multi_entry owner; only its ordinary wrapper is credited.

Inherited in-place hybrid-build limitations remain: complete original-armlink layout/unwind reconstruction, runtime behavior, cross-host reproduction and lower RomFS IVFC traversal are separate properties not proven by these matching checks.
